reviews.text: I’ve been tracking feeds in another app for two months. Then I switch over to this, and I’m so glad I did! The graphs are so awesome. You can track a lot of different ways and the app is user friendly. I love that you can export a PDF of all the important information for doctor visits. I also get notifications when my husband has finished a feed! Would recommend!

I think this the most in-depth and detailed app I’ve used for feeding - and I have now used three different apps over the course of my baby’s life. The developer really has thought of everything, and I appreciate that they are so open to suggestions and feedback as well. I am only one day into using the app so far, but I’m especially excited to see what it comes up with in terms of trends and prediction soon!
Very useful app! It saves me both time and mental effort, while giving me a clear and easy overview. Definitely worth downloading!
La app es muy útil y fácil de utilizar! Es una excelente herramienta para llevar un control de la alimentación y crecimiento de tu bebé
Super enkel app och har hjälpt mig att få koll på min amning. Slipper oroa mig att mitt barn går hungrig! Super ⭐️
Love it! Super easy to use, and the flowcast function actually helps saving formula. Will you get Norwegian language as well?
This is one the best feeding apps I have tried. The layout is better than Talli or any of the others I have tried thus far. Highly recommend. The dev is super cool too!

This app has such amazing potential!! There are so many thoughtful additions including milestone tracking, solid foods/reactions, breast/bottle feeds and pumping. I would love to see a diaper tracker added in as well. Overall this is a great app for logging feeds, milestones, and growth!
